_doc: Tells (Dungeon Alive slice 5; src/tells.py). Brandon: players must pay attention to lore, weaknesses and abilities (stay away from things that confuse; use ranged). A creature that can do something dangerous SHOWS it: the first time in a run that the hero sees a kind, the Chronicler says its worst tell, with what to do about it. Observe (O) says every tell of a creature at any time. Tells come from what the creature really does: an attack 'effect' (data/monsters.json) or one of its flags. 'order' ranks the effects, worst first; 'min_chance' ignores an attack effect rarer than this.

effects.gaze_paralyze: Do not meet the eyes of {the}: its gaze can hold you where you stand. Something between you, or a mirror, breaks it.
effects.paralyzed: Your limbs feel heavy just watching {the}. Its touch can hold you still. Do not let it reach you: fight it from a distance.
effects.confused: The eyes of {the} swirl with a sick, shifting light. Get close and you will not think straight. Keep your distance, or end it fast.
effects.sleeping: {The} hums a drowsy, rocking note. It can put you to sleep where you stand.
effects.frozen: Frost crackles round {the}. It can freeze you solid.
effects.teleportitis: {The} flickers at the edges. Its touch can fling you somewhere else.
effects.feared: Looking at {the} makes your stomach drop. It can break your nerve and send you running.
effects.blinded: {The} spits and sprays. It goes for the eyes.
effects.silenced: {The} moves in a pocket of dead quiet. It can take your voice, and your spells with it.
effects.stunned: {The} hits like a falling wall. Its blows can leave you dazed.
effects.immobilized: {The} trails sticky strands. It can pin you where you stand.
effects.splits: {The} looks as if it would come apart and keep coming. Strike it the wrong way and there will be two.
effects.revive_once_on_death: {The} has died before. It may not stay dead the first time.
effects.weakened: {The} feeds on strength. What it touches weakens.
effects.diseased: {The} reeks of rot. Its wounds fester.
effects.poisoned: The fangs of {the} glisten wet. Its bite is poison.
effects.regeneration: The old scars of {the} have closed without a mark. It heals itself: finish it, do not wear it down.
effects.summon_kind: {The} carries the means to call others. Kill it before it calls.
effects.pull_chance: {The} has a long reach with a hook to it. It will drag you in.
effects.sp_drain: {The} sniffs at your pack. It is after your food.
effects.can_charge: {The} paws the ground. Across open ground it will charge; make it come to you round a corner.
effects.can_phase_blink: {The} flickers from place to place. Distance will not save you.
effects.bleeding: {The} has hooked claws made for tearing. Its wounds bleed.
effects.burning: Heat shimmers off {the}. It sets what it hits alight.
effects.slowed: A chill clings to {the}. What it hits moves sluggishly after.
effects.hallucinating: The air round {the} wavers like heat. It fills heads with things that are not there.
